verse.verse_1: Say (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)): "He is Allah, (the) One.
verse.verse_2: "Allah-us-Samad (The Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, He neither eats nor drinks).
verse.verse_3: "He begets not, nor was He begotten;
verse.verse_4: "And there is none co-equal or comparable unto Him."
